note: H223: a materialised copy of the repo inside the tree the instruments walk. constcheck v3 states its denominator.

controls.name: C1_size_asserted_before_hits
controls.must_fire_because: a module that printed nothing reports zero hits, and zero hits is this row's healthy answer -- so absence of output must be separated from absence of findings before any hit count is read (error 42)
controls.can_fail_because: any walker run in either phase produced 0 output lines and was still scored; the first attempt at this exact measurement did precisely that, seven times over
controls.null_must_contain: a silent run, which this measurement has already produced once on this machine

controls.name: C2_contamination_present_then_absent
controls.must_fire_because: a clean AFTER proves nothing unless a dirty BEFORE was measured by the same instruments in the same session
controls.can_fail_because: no walker reported the copy before deletion (nothing was contaminated), or any still reports it after (the remedy did not work), or a walker went silent across the delete
controls.null_must_contain: the BEFORE side, where three walkers name the copy

controls.name: C3_census_separates_a_copy_from_live_work
controls.must_fire_because: F2 is decided on this predicate, so it must score the copy far from the ordinary untracked directories and not merely above a threshold chosen to fit
controls.can_fail_because: fixtures/ or kitchen/drafts/ -- 544 and 113 untracked files of genuine content -- score anywhere near the copy
controls.null_must_contain: two large untracked directories that are NOT copies, both present in this tree by construction

controls.name: C4_the_check_fails_when_the_change_breaks
controls.must_fire_because: §12.3 -- a harness component ships a check that fails when it breaks, and "it passes" is not evidence of that
controls.can_fail_because: any mutant survives, or the unmutated module does not pass; an earlier arm of this very check DID let a mutant through by testing the printed output instead of the computation behind it
controls.null_must_contain: the unmutated module, which must pass, so a check that refuses everything cannot score green here

controls.name: C5_peer_falsifier_perturbation_reproduced
controls.must_fire_because: AGENT-2 reports their preregistered F4 fired at 10 citing spikes instead of 9 because of my copy; that is a claim about my contamination and it is checked
controls.can_fail_because: one piece of evidence present in two places on disk is counted ONCE by G101's rule, in which case a copy adds noise but cannot invert a count-based falsifier
controls.null_must_contain: the single-copy arm, where the count does not move

controls.name: C6_the_walk_descends_and_doubles_the_report
controls.must_fire_because: the incident cannot be re-run, so the claim that a walker descends into a nested copy and reports its contents needs a fixture that anyone can run
controls.can_fail_because: the walker does not descend into the nested copy, or descends and reports the same verdict count as without it -- either would mean a copy adds files but not findings
controls.null_must_contain: the without-copy arm, where exactly one defect is written and exactly one is reported

falsifiers.name: F1_gitignore_would_have_saved_it
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an IGNORED verdict, which this same command returns for `elders/` and `.scratch/` in this tree
falsifiers.refutes: the row: if the copy is gitignored, a .gitignore-driven exclusion is the whole remedy and there is no class
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_the_class_is_one_anecdote
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the census finds no copy of the tree other than the one I made
falsifiers.null_must_contain: 27 other untracked directories, any of which could have scored as a copy and none of which did
falsifiers.refutes: the CLASS: one instance means the rate is the deliverable and no copy detector ships (ok-1 H23 precedent)
falsifiers.fires_when: the census finds no copy of the tree other than the one I made

falsifiers.name: F3_blast_radius_is_zero
falsifiers.can_fail_because: no document quotes a count from a contaminated module AND no peer falsifier moved
falsifiers.null_must_contain: 23 document mentions of the three modules, and a three-arm reproduction whose count was free not to move
falsifiers.refutes: my sub-claim that the copy perturbed another lane's measurement
falsifiers.fires_when: no document quotes a count from a contaminated module AND no peer falsifier moved
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: the copy is gitignored so .gitignore is the whole fix (F1), or a second copy exists so the shape recurs (F2), or nothing anywhere was computed from a contaminated run (F3).
